entries.before: Customer-managed telecom provider information must be supplied through the Microsoft Security Store by 18 September 2026.
entries.after: Choose Your Own Telephony Provider: provider information becomes available from 18 September 2026 and configuration from 30 October 2026, ahead of the 1 February 2027 retirement of Microsoft-provided SMS and voice.
Microsoft Entra ID: Retirement of Custom Controls in Conditional Access and migration to External MFA

entries.before: Conditional Access custom controls become read-only on 30 September 2026; policies still referencing them must move to authentication strengths or external methods.
entries.after: MC1422061: from September 2026 (no day printed) administrators can no longer create or modify Conditional Access custom controls; full retirement May 2027; migrate to external MFA with the Require multifactor authentication grant.

entries.before: Microsoft Entra Cloud Sync provisions users, groups and memberships from Entra ID into on-premises Active Directory Domain Services with the SID preserved, reversing the direction of hybrid identity. On 1 September 2026 Microsoft named this in the September Entra blog as “Manage identity lifecycle from the cloud with Microsoft Entra Cloud Sync”, so it is no longer documentation-only.
entries.after: On 31 August 2026 Microsoft deleted the Cloud Sync article on provisioning users, groups and memberships from Entra ID into on-premises AD DS; Learn now documents only group provisioning to AD DS, with synced user member references.

entries.before: September 2026 Scan Cab published, but without the Office update metadata
entries.after: September 2026 Scan Cab covers the Office update after all; no second cab is coming

entries.before: The September 2026 Scan Cab was published at 14:00 PDT on 8 September, resolving the delay announced in MC1469328; it carries no metadata for Office update KB5002923 and a second Scan Cab covering that will follow on a date Microsoft has not given.
entries.after: The September 2026 Scan Cab was published on 8 September; Microsoft corrected the notice on 10 September to say it does include the Office KB5002923 metadata and that no additional Scan Cab will be released.

entries.before: Images containing QR codes from external senders will be obscured by default and require the user to reveal them before viewing or scanning. In development, targeted for general availability in October 2026, worldwide, on Android, desktop, iOS and Mac.
entries.after: Images containing QR codes from external senders will be obscured by default and require the user to reveal them before viewing or scanning. In development, targeted for general availability in October 2026, worldwide, on Android, desktop, iOS and Mac. MC1470410 (10 September) dates it: Targeted Release early October, GA mid-October 2026.

entries.before: Purview auto-labeling is being extended for enterprise-scale label policy management and validation: expanded SharePoint scope capacity, more administrative control over policies, and enhanced reporting on auto-labeling operations. Preview from September 2026, general availability targeted for October 2026.
entries.after: Purview auto-labeling is being extended for enterprise-scale label policy management and validation: expanded SharePoint scope capacity, more administrative control over policies, and enhanced reporting on auto-labeling operations. Preview from September 2026, general availability targeted for October 2026. MC1469958 (9 September): simulation capacity 4 million to 20 million items, GA from late October 2026.

entries.before: Endpoint DLP alters archive-file classification behaviour on Windows endpoints, which changes which archive contents a policy matches.
entries.after: Endpoint DLP alters archive-file classification behaviour on Windows endpoints, which changes which archive contents a policy matches. On 10 September Microsoft pulled the release forward from December to October 2026.

entries.before: From early October 2026, with EWSEnabled True, EWS requires an EWSAllowedAppIDs list; where the tenant has not written one Microsoft generates it from the previous 60 days of observed EWS use, which may omit infrequent applications. Rollout completes late June 2027. Changes take up to 24 hours to propagate.
entries.after: From early October 2026, with EWSEnabled True, EWS requires an EWSAllowedAppIDs list; where the tenant has not written one Microsoft generates it from the previous 60 days of observed EWS use, which may omit infrequent applications, and it will not overwrite a list the tenant configured. Rollout completes late April 2027. Changes take up to 24 hours to propagate.
